events.title: SPACE WALK Demo is Live Now!
events.summary: The SPACE WALK demo is now available to play on Steam. After 2 years building, testing, changing and refining the game, it feels great to finally let people experience it for themselves. In the demo, you join the Pioneer Program, live aboard your own orbital station, prepare for EVA and head down to the lunar surface to explore, collect resources and uncover what’s out there. If you play the demo, I’d love to hear what you think. ------------------------------------------------------------------
